slides.heading: Manual Mode
slides.subheading: You control all three exposure variables — nothing changes unless you change it.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Manual Mode gives you full control over exposure.
It matters because nothing shifts automatically — your creative intent stays locked.
You set aperture, shutter speed, and ISO yourself.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: You set aperture, shutter speed, and ISO yourself.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Set aperture for depth of field.
Rebalance exposure until histogram is centered.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Lock two settings for your style and adjust the third for exposure.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Forgetting ISO is still part of the triangle and letting it drift too high.
